d:
Ejukeshan ministri ki yunifaid distrikt informeshan sistam for ejukeshan plas (UDISE+) riport 2025-26 ke anusar, bharat men ek lakh se adhik singal-tichar skul hain. yani aise skul jahan sirf ek tichar hain. aise skulon men lagbhag 30 lakh students parhte hain. singal-tichar vale skulon ki list men aandhr pradesh sabse oopar hai, jahan 16 hazar se zyada singal-tichar skul hain. bibisi nyuz telugu ki tim aandhr pradesh ke ek aise hi skul men pahunchi. dekhie, kaise chalta hai sindhuvara ka ye sarkari singal tichar skul.
Riportar: pavan kanth digavalli, lakkoju shrinivas
